subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a proactive STOP-driven repeated-prompt mode in core, or support only an opt-in hard budget for the existing tool-calling loop?
rationale: Current main implements only reactive tool-loop detection, while the linked PR implements a narrower hard budget. Choosing whether proactive repetition belongs in core determines the runtime lifecycle, termination contract, configuration surface, and whether this issue remains separate from the budget work.

options.title: Separate both contracts
options.body: Keep proactive Ralph execution and runaway-loop budgeting distinct, specifying and testing each independently before implementation.

options.title: Budget only
options.body: Use the linked iteration-budget direction as the supported core safeguard and decline proactive repeated-prompt execution.

options.title: Unified loop mode
options.body: Design one configuration that combines proactive repetition and hard limits, accepting a larger and more coupled runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Separate both contracts
recommendation.body: Keep proactive Ralph execution and runaway-loop budgeting distinct, specifying and testing each independently before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the closest current loop-safety feature and already reviewed this exact issue as needing product judgment.
